div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 企业发布会 / 商业广告棚拍需求

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
现场是否有弧形 LED 虚拟影棚
还是传统绿幕影棚?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
被拍主体是否包含高反光汽车、
玻璃器皿或复杂飞散发丝?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
⚠️ 极高绿幕溢色返工风险!
强烈建议切换至 LED ICVFX 影棚或实景

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 标准绿幕拍摄 + 后期 Nuke 抠像合成

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
物理摄影机是否发生推拉摇移
(Dolly / Truck / Crane)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
✅ 标准 ICVFX 双视锥 + Genlock 管线:
1. 内视锥: 6DoF 追踪驱动 3DGS / UE5 实时透视
2. 外视锥/天幕: 360° 16-bit AIGC HDRI 环境反射
3. PTPv2 + Tri-Level Genlock 全链路快门锁相

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ✅ 简化模式: 4K 10-bit AIGC 视频背景 + Genlock 锁相
